author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic / character visual design collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition collateral. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking hand-drawn / Japanese / warm style. Comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
